  REDIS_URL            source=env       ok                                   process.env.REDIS_URL

code:
SECRET_HINTS = ("password", "secret", "token", "api_key", "apikey", "private_key", "credential")

ITEMS = [
    {"key": "DATABASE_URL", "source": "env", "site": "process.env.DATABASE_URL"},
    {"key": "REDIS_URL", "source": "env", "site": "process.env.REDIS_URL"},
    {"key": "LOG_LEVEL", "source": "file", "site": "config/default.json"},
    {"key": "PORT", "source": "hardcoded", "site": "src/server.js:12"},
    {"key": "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY", "source": "hardcoded", "site": "src/pay.js:7"},
    {"key": "DB_PASSWORD", "source": "hardcoded", "site": "src/db.js:4"},
    {"key": "FEATURE_NEW_UI", "source": "env", "site": "process.env.FEATURE_NEW_UI"},
    {"key": "SMTP_HOST", "source": "file", "site": "config/default.json"},
]

VERDICT = {}

for it in ITEMS:
    is_secret = any(h in it["key"].lower() for h in SECRET_HINTS)
    if it["source"] == "env":
        verdict = "ok"
    elif it["source"] == "file":
        verdict = "ok_externalized_but_prefer_env"
    else:
        verdict = "VIOLATION_CRITICAL_HARDCODED_SECRET" if is_secret else "VIOLATION_HARDCODED_CONFIG"
    VERDICT[id(it)] = verdict
    it["verdict"] = verdict

print("items=%d" % len(ITEMS))
for it in ITEMS:
    print("  %-20s source=%-9s %-36s %s" % (it["key"], it["source"], it["verdict"], it["site"]))

violations = [i for i in ITEMS if i["verdict"].startswith("VIOLATION")]
critical = [i for i in violations if i["verdict"].endswith("SECRET")]
print("=== summary ===")
print("compliant=%d violations=%d critical=%d" % (len(ITEMS) - len(violations), len(violations), len(critical)))
print("compliance_pct=%.1f" % round(100.0 * (len(ITEMS) - len(violations)) / len(ITEMS), 1))
print("=== judgement ===")
print("port_hardcoded_flagged=%s" % any(i["key"] == "PORT" for i in violations))
print("secret_hardcoded_is_critical=%s" % any(i["key"] == "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY" for i in critical))
print("env_never_flagged=%s" % (not any(i["source"] == "env" for i in violations)))
print("file_externalized_not_violation=%s" % (not any(i["key"] == "LOG_LEVEL" for i in violations)))
